text:
Riya Sharma: Hi all — I start next week and trying to get a head start on docs. I can see the Engineering onboarding checklist in Notion but it's view-only. Also, our onboarding cohort (3 folks) would like editor access so we can fill out ramp notes. What's the fastest way to get 'cohort' access?

Jordan Lee: Welcome Riya! We usually add new hires to the docs-editors group, but for cohorts we sometimes add a temporary page-level Editor role to the specific Onboarding space. Ping @devex with the page URL and list of people + their emails.

devex: Quick checklist to request cohort editor rights:
1) Include full Notion URL for the Onboarding space or the specific list.
2) Provide Red ID or work email for each person.
3) State duration (e.g., 30 days).
4) If you need to change templates, indicate which ones.
Send that info here or open a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk.

docs-bot: Note: we avoid granting workspace-level Editor to new hires by default. Page-level Editors are preferred. Also please follow naming conventions when creating pages: prefix with "Onboard - <Name> - <Team>".

Riya Sharma: Thanks — two follow ups: (1) Is there a preferred template for "Ramp Notes" vs "Weekly 1:1"? I found multiple with slightly different fields. (2) Can I duplicate the engineering checklist and remove company-confidential sections before sharing with the cohort?

Marta Gomez: For ramp notes, use "Ramp Notes (Canonical)" under Redwood > People Ops > Templates — that one has the fields the managers expect (Goals, Blockers, Demos, Contacts). Weekly 1:1 template is separate and kept under each manager's team page.

Jordan Lee: On duplicating canonical checklists: yes you can duplicate for cohort use. If you plan to remove confidential sections, do it in your duplicated copy in "My workspace". If you want to maintain a shared cohort page, put the duplicate under the Onboarding space and set a page property "Visibility" -> "Cohort" and add Owners.

devex: Also: if the template you duplicate has database properties, they should persist when duplicated. To make sure managers see the Owner & Status fields, edit the template's database view and select the default visible columns before duplicating.

Riya Sharma: Great — I'll gather emails for the 3 of us and DM @devex with the URLs and duration. One last question: who do I talk to if I spot outdated docs in the Engineering space that should be archived?

Marta Gomez: Raise a "Docs cleanup" PR in the docs backlog board (Product > Docs Backlog) or add a comment on the page tagging the current owner. If it's unlabeled, ping me (Marta) and I'll help route it to the right owner.

Riya Sharma: Perfect. Thanks everyone — will do that now. :raised_hands:
